title: Hardlink staged by git so the secret enters the object store
reason_not_testable: The commit blob and any pushed copy sit outside the output stream. A hook can only redact later output that prints the blob (covered by LEAK-1985-style O checks), so the persistence of the leaked value cannot be asserted by a hook fixture. Non-hook controls: pre-commit or CI secret scanning, rotation, and history rewrite before push.
